tools.name: create_org_chart
tools.description: Create an org chart from a list of people and get a link that opens it in the SimplOrg editor. Up to 500 people. The link stays valid for 30 days; after opening it the user can save or share the chart from SimplOrg.

id.description: Short unique id for this person, e.g. "ceo" or "p12". Used only for reports_to references.

name.description: Full name (or role name if the person is unknown, e.g. "Open position").

department.description: Department or team, shown as a colored tag.

reports_to.description: id of this person's direct manager. Omit for top-level people.

also_reports_to.description: ids of additional (dotted-line / matrix) managers, drawn as dashed lines.

people.description: Everyone on the chart, in any order.

tools.name: read_org_chart
tools.description: Read the people and reporting lines from a SimplOrg chart link (an AI-created link or a share link). Use it to update an existing chart: edit the returned list and pass it to create_org_chart.

link.description: A simplorg.com link to the chart.
